A '''Mag-6 Injector''' was a component that could be used in [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]]. It cost 14000 [[Trugut/Legends|truguts]]. The junk dealer [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] often sold them to podracer pilots requiring upgrades to their vehicles.
